pgda.pgda_period: hourly steps over 18.6 years (one lunar nutation cycle)

pgda_period.period_note: The PGDA label gives the length of its simulation (18.6 years, hourly) but not its dates; this check starts at the first date in that label.
pgda_period.angles: Astronomy Engine in the page's code (src/moonsky.js), not JPL Horizons
pgda_period.rule: share of hourly steps with any part of the disc above the skyline (the PGDA rule)
